Animation duration correctly set to duration-150 (150ms) for both overlay and content
useRef pattern in DealsPage (_sel/_setSel with selRef) correctly preserves content during exit animation
Same ref pattern correctly implemented in TreasuryPage and TransactionHistoryPage

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dialog close overlay fix verified. Key implementation: dialog.jsx uses bg-black/40 overlay (reduced from bg-black/80) with duration-150 animation. DealsPage, TreasuryPage, TransactionHistoryPage use useRef pattern (_sel/_setSel with selRef) to keep dialog content visible during exit animation. Dialog open prop uses _sel (so it starts closing when null) while content uses sel (derived from ref, so content stays visible during fade-out). UsersPage uses separate open/edit state without ref pattern. All tested pages: /deals, /treasury, /transactions, /users. No black flash/overlay artifact observed during close animations.
